# Agent Constraints

A few hard rules for any AI coding agent (Copilot coding agent, VS Code Agent mode, etc.) working in this repository. Path-scoped guidance lives in `.github/instructions/*.instructions.md`; this file is the short list of non-negotiables.

## Must do
- Run `npm test` (or the closest workspace-scoped equivalent, e.g. `npm test --workspace=api`) after any code edit, and include the result in the PR description.
- Run `npm run build` for the workspace you changed before opening a PR.
- Keep diffs minimal and scoped to the issue being addressed.
- Update or add tests alongside any behavior change.

## Must not
- Never edit anything under `infra/` or `.github/workflows/` — infrastructure and CI changes require a human.
- Never commit secrets, tokens, or `.env*` files.
- Never bypass the repository pattern in `api/src/db/` — go through the existing repositories.
- Never introduce `any` in TypeScript without an inline justification comment.

## Style
- Match existing naming, formatting, and module structure.
- Prefer adding to existing utilities over creating new ones.
